## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready safety vital signs, derives Week 24 and end-of-treatment flags, calculates descriptive statistics by measure, position, visit, and treatment, and adds treatment denominators.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADVS`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: vital-sign measure
- `ATPT`: planned measurement position/time
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `ABLFL`: baseline flag
- `AVISIT`: analysis visit
- `ANL01FL/SAFFL`: selection flags
- `TRTP`: planned treatment
- `ARM in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
